parameters.query:
SELECT
    id,
    business_name,
    instagram,
    website,
    email,
    phone,
    status,
    created_at
FROM leads
WHERE status = 'NEW'
  AND website IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(website) <> ''
ORDER BY created_at ASC
LIMIT 1;

parameters.text:
=You are an expert B2B sales intelligence analyst.

Analyze the company's website information below.

Company Title:
{{$json.title}}

Meta Description:
{{$json.description}}

Website Content:
{{$json.content}}

Your task:

1. Identify the company's industry.
2. Write a concise 2-3 sentence summary of what the company does.
3. List the company's main services.
4. Identify the most likely ideal customer.
5. Estimate company size using one of:
   - Startup
   - Small Business
   - Small to Medium Enterprise (SME)
   - Mid-Market
   - Enterprise
6. Determine the buying intent based on the website.
7. Recommend ONE service from our company that would best fit this lead.
8. Give a lead score from 0 to 100.
9. Explain briefly why you assigned that score.

IMPORTANT RULES

• Use ONLY the supplied website information.
• Infer reasonable conclusions when obvious from the content.
• Do NOT invent products or services that are not mentioned.
• If a field truly cannot be determined, return an empty string "".
• services MUST always be an array.
• score MUST always be a number.
• Return ONLY valid JSON.
• Do NOT use Markdown.
• Do NOT wrap the response inside ```json.

Return exactly this JSON format:

{
  "industry": "",
  "summary": "",
  "services": [],
  "ideal_customer": "",
  "company_size": "",
  "buying_intent": "",
  "recommended_service": "",
  "score": 0,
  "reason": ""
}
